---
title: "format-links with only an explicit href link"
format:
  html:
    format-links:
      - text: Quarto
        href: https://quarto.org/
        icon: globe
  typst: default
  docx: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        selectors:
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="https://quarto.org/"]'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606-href.pdf"]'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606-href.docx"]'
        counts: [3, 1, 1, 1]
---

`format-links` has a single `{text, href}` link, which names no format.
It is added on top of the default links, so Typst and docx keep theirs (#9606).
